description: Owner request 2026-10-12: comprehensive diagnosis that everything entered in Telegram (CRM) matches the website. Rerun with description list/paragraph rule mirrored from the renderer, stage conflicts by CRM status, and empty GE accepted when CRM GE is empty; verifiers adapted to the current card layout (SEO title, um-gallery, chip stage, tehtekst description). Read-only: transient CRM copy, server card pages, catalog, directory listing (GET via API); public pages and live price JSON (HTTPS GET). Per published car compares title/year/VIN/mileage/engine/fuel/gearbox/drive/colour, photos, catalog photo count, UA/GE prices on card, catalog and live JSON, description, stage; plus published-set, orphan pages and stale serving. No writes; no private columns exported.
title: Read-only CRM to site consistency audit
